title: pcl_session.json: the lab card of one session
description: One small card per session, the same fields for every instrument. A later version only adds fields; a field never changes its meaning or type, because Globus Search keeps the first type it sees.

instrument.description: The instrument slug. It equals the name of the instrument folder that holds the session.

session.description: The session's name as its tool made it, without any _copyN.

session_id.description: The tool's own unique id (Raman: session.json session_id). Copies share it.

started_utc.description: When acquisition started, ISO 8601 UTC with Z. Date searches use this, never a folder name.

ended_utc.description: When the last item was taken (Raman: the newest point's completed_utc), or null.

simulated.description: True when any part was simulated or when nobody can tell; never null.

sample_ids.description: Sample identifiers as typed, always strings, always a list ([] when none).

operator.description: Who ran the session, as typed. Personal: kept out of Search unless the lab agrees.

notes.description: Free text typed at the instrument. Personal: kept out of Search unless the lab agrees.

items.description: How many measurements the session holds.

completion.description: How the session ended. Raman: finished -> complete, stopped -> partial, failed -> failed, ended -> unknown.

format.description: What the files are, e.g. raman-session/1 folder.

instrument_info.description: Model, serial, firmware, unit as the instrument reports them. Never sent to Search.

uploaded_utc.description: When the upload's copy was made.

upload_id.description: The uploader's id (u followed by 12 hex digits).

written_by.description: The program that wrote the card.

extra.description: Anything specific to one instrument. Kept in SQLite as JSON, never sent to Search.
